title: Badge Overflow
description: A component that intelligently manages badge overflow by measuring available space and displaying only what fits with an overflow indicator.

The component will automatically use the item itself as the label.       {#snippet renderBadge(item: string, label: string)}         {label}     {/snippet}  With Object Arrays  When using object arrays, the getBadgeLabel prop is required to extract the label from each item.   item.name}     {#snippet renderBadge(item, label)}         {label}     {/snippet}  Examples  Multi-line Overflow  Display badges across multiple lines using the lineCount prop.  Interactive Tags  Tags Interactive demo showing how to add and remove tags with overflow handling.
